market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $2,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at ~$2,334-$2,354 on May 6-7. Dipping to $2,000 in May requires ~14-15% drawdown over ~24 days. With BTC trending up and broader risk assets rallying, ETH is unlikely to sustain such a deep dip. Possible on a sharp risk-off event but base rate low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: ETH-specific weakness or broader crypto sell-off
